response.goal: Build an n8n workflow that triggers on new responses from two Typeform forms, checks the Google Sheet for duplicate emails and skips them, adds a new row with name, email, company, form name and timestamp, posts a message to the #sales Slack channel with a link to the row, and emails if any step fails.

plan.step: Configure the Typeform triggers for both demo request forms to feed data into the n8n workflow
Implement the duplicate check logic by querying the Google Sheet for existing email addresses to skip duplicates
Map the form fields including name, email, company, form name, and timestamp into a new Google Sheets row
Configure the Slack notification to post a message to the #sales channel with a link to the new row
Set up error handling and email alerts to notify if any step in the workflow fails

milestones.name: Workflow Implementation and Duplicate Check
milestones.deliverable: Configured Typeform triggers, Google Sheets integration, and duplicate email checking logic in self-hosted n8n.

milestones.name: Notifications and Error Handling
milestones.deliverable: Slack sales channel alert integration with row link, plus error handling and failure notification emails.

risks.risk: Typeform payload structure might change or differ between the two forms
risks.mitigation: Normalize incoming data fields at the start of the n8n workflow before performing the duplicate check and sheet insertion.

risks.risk: Hourly billing structure without a capped total may lead to scope creep or budget uncertainty
risks.mitigation: Establish a clear estimated hour cap per milestone and provide regular updates on time spent.

questions: What email service or node would you prefer for the failure notification emails?
How should the link to the Google Sheet row be formatted for the Slack message?
assumptions: The client has admin access to their self-hosted n8n instance and can provide API credentials or webhooks access for Typeform, Google Sheets, and Slack.
The Google Sheet already contains the required columns for name, email, company, form name, and timestamp.
